fields.name: Inactive
documentation: State used when an addon restriction is not being enforced.

fields.name: Activating
documentation: State used during the dispatch of ADDON_RESTRICTION_STATE_CHANGED to infer that a restriction is about to become active, but won't be enforced until event dispatch has completed.

fields.name: Active
documentation: State used when an addon restriction is presently being enforced.

fields.name: Combat
documentation: The player is actively affecting combat.

fields.name: Encounter
documentation: The player is actively participating in an instance encounter.

fields.name: ChallengeMode
documentation: The player is in an active and incomplete challenge mode or mythic keystone dungeon.

fields.name: PvPMatch
documentation: The player is in an active and incomplete PvP match.

fields.name: Map
documentation: The player is on a map that applies addon restrictions.

fields.name: Chat
documentation: The player is in a state where addon chat communications are restricted.
